title: 第23章 形势一转再转第24章 求婚壮举
slug: 和女帝双修后我出剑即无敌
lines: 郑萱的眼睛都红了，因为哥哥郑元一步步向着擂台走了过去。
“郑公子不要啊！”
楚琳大声的喊着，郑元一旦踏上擂台，有可能就会被逍遥公子杀死。
郑元看着擂台那边的楚琳笑着挥了挥手，然后身形一晃。
“果然楚小姐和这小子有私情，那么今天就留不得他了。”
擂台上的逍遥公子任飞鸿把刚才的那一切尽收眼底。
楚小姐分明是被这小子迷惑了心神，逍遥公子袖子里的拳头攥的紧紧，羡慕嫉妒恨在心里轰然而起。
只有自己这样的人才能配得上城主女儿。
嗡！
任飞鸿手里的描金扇一指，一道寒光向着郑元的胸前而去，劲道十足，凌厉无比。
“厉害啊，这莫非就是绝技夺命连环指？”
台下众人都是大惊失色不已，再加上开脉五层修为，半空中传来一道呼啸声。
郑元一脸坚毅之色，一剑射了出去。
砰的一声响，那道指气和长剑撞击在了一起。
郑元感觉到一股无形的力量从对面传了过来，根本挡不住。
噗！
郑元嘴里吐出一大口鲜血，身形更是被震退了十几步开外。
果然开脉三层修为和开脉五层修为差得太远了。
郑族众人嘴里大喊着，那就是郑元被逍遥公子的夺命连环指逼得连连后退。
根本没有任何抗衡之力，此时不断吐出的鲜血已经把郑元的胸前衣服都染红了。
“郑公子，你快认输啊，这样下去你会死的……”
此时楚琳嘴里大声喊着，想要冲上擂台上却被一道无形的真气震了回去。
因为这座擂台是经过中级阵法师刻制的。
只有被人打下去，或者自己跳下去认输，否则战斗中别人根本无法进入到里面。
“小子，现在你跪地上给本公子磕头求饶还能饶你一命，本公子说话算数。”
逍遥公子任飞鸿并没有着急把郑元打败。
反而是猫戏老鼠一样，因为楚小姐越心疼，越担心，自己就越兴奋。
就是让城主女儿楚琳看到，谁才是强者。
砰的一声响，郑元被逍遥公子的一道劲气震飞了十几米远，狠狠地摔在了地上。
content_en:
"Brother..."
Zheng Xuan's eyes were red because her brother Zheng Yuan walked towards the ring step by step.
"Master Zheng, I don't want it!"
Chu Lin shouted loudly that once Zheng Yuan stepped onto the ring, he might be killed by Young Master Xiaoyao.
Zheng Yuan looked at Chu Lin on the other side of the ring, smiled, waved, and then swayed.
"As expected, Miss Chu has an affair with this boy, so we can't keep him today."
Ren Feihong, the young master Xiaoyao on the stage, had a panoramic view of everything that had just happened.
Miss Chu was clearly confused by this boy. The fists in Mr. Xiaoyao's sleeves were clenched tightly, and envy, jealousy, and hatred surged in her heart.
Only someone like him can be worthy of the city lord's daughter.
Buzz!
Ren Feihong pointed at the gold-painted fan in his hand, and a ray of cold light shot toward Zheng Yuan's chest. It was full of force and fierce.
"Awesome, could this be the death-killing chain of fingers?"
Everyone in the audience was shocked, and coupled with the fifth-level cultivation of Kaimai, a whistling sound was heard in the air.
Zheng Yuan looked determined and shot out his sword.
With a bang, the finger energy and the long sword collided.
Zheng Yuan felt an invisible force coming from the opposite side, which was impossible to stop.
puff!
Zheng Yuan spat out a large mouthful of blood, and was even shaken back a dozen steps.
Sure enough, there is a huge difference between the third-level cultivation of meridians and the fifth-level cultivation of meridians.
"Zheng Yuan..."
Everyone in the Zheng clan shouted that Zheng Yuan was forced back by Young Master Xiaoyao's deadly chain fingers.
There was no resistance at all, and the blood that was constantly spitting out at this time had already stained Zheng Yuan's chest and clothes red.
"Mr. Zheng, give in quickly, you will die if you continue like this..."
At this time, Chu Lin shouted loudly and wanted to rush onto the ring, but was knocked back by an invisible force of energy.
Because this arena was carved by an intermediate formation master.
The only way is to be beaten down, or to jump in and admit defeat, otherwise others will not be able to enter at all during the battle.
"Boy, now if you kneel down and kowtow to me for mercy, I will spare your life. I will keep my word."
Young Master Xiaoyao Ren Feihong was not in a hurry to defeat Zheng Yuan.
Instead, it was like a cat playing with a mouse, because the more distressed and worried Miss Chu was, the more excited she became.
Just to let Chu Lin, the daughter of the city lord, see who is the strong one.
With a bang, Zheng Yuan was blown away more than ten meters by Young Master Xiaoyao's force, and fell hard to the ground.
